tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bse mgon chen pos rmi lam du lung bstan byung ba bzhin sgo rum mgon khang steng gi rje btsun gyi gzim chung mdo sbug chom rdibs su 'gro la khad pa'i thog dang logs bris sogs la nyams gso dang zhabs rtog bgyis pa'i dkar chag gi yi ge bzhugs// na mo gu ru buddha tri ṇi ye mahā mu dra dharmā dha tu bo dha yantu/ bla ma sangs rgyas gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kyi dbyings phyag rgya chen po rtogs par gyur cig gdan sa kun gyi gtsug rgyan dpal sa skya'i/ /bla brang mchog gyur gzim spyil dkar po yi/ /bse mgon yid bzhin nor bu'i pho brang steng / /rje btsun gong ma rnam lnga'i bsti ba'i gnas/ /gzim chung phu mda' thigs khang bcas pa'i thog /lo mang ches pas hrul por nyan pa la/ /nyams gso dgos pa ye shes mgon po yis/ /rmi lam ngang du lung bstan byung ba bzhin/ /chos med za nyal 'chag gi rnal 'byor pa/ /sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ /gong ma'i gzim chung thog gi shing cha rnams/ /rnying pa phra mo tsam yang ma gyar cing / /gsar pa bzang po'i zhabs rtog dang bcas te/ /bshus 'bubs tshul gyi nyams gso gang dgos dang / /de dang dus mnyam logs bris rnying pa yi/ /nyams pa gsos dang gsar pa 'ga' bgyis pa/ /legs byas 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag gzhan 'gro ba'i sgrib kun byang gyur nas/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/ /re ba bzhin du bstan pa cher rgyas shing / /nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag /bde ba can nam mngon dga'i zhing mchog tu/ /dpon slob kun kyang 'bral med lhan cig tu/ /skyes nas rang don spangs rtogs mthar phyin shog /slar yang gang 'dul sprul pas srid mtha'i bar/ /spyi dang bye brag dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa nam langs nyi ma shar ba ltar/ /dkar 'jam nyid du bdag gis byed gyur cig /de de bzhin du gyur cig

de las gzhan du nam yang ma gyur cig bha dra ti thi li kha taṃ/ bzang po'i tshes la bris pa'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ/ thams cad bkra shis// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ rje btsun gyi gzim chung thog dang logs bris sogs la nyams gso bgyis pa'i dkar chag/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
